label: Nothing knows anything at a degree above its own degree of act
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred. For every x, x's degree of act bounds x's power of knowing (PowerOfKnowingBoundedBy, definition 431287d4): whenever x knows some y at a degree d, d is at most x's degree of act. After ST I q.12 a.4 (what is known is in the knower according to the mode of the knower) and a.7 (the created light of glory, by which the blessed see God, is finite). The knower's degree of act is meant as its whole act, including an added perfection such as the light of glory, so the premise does not exclude the beatific vision; it bounds its degree. The measures have no state index: a knower before and after receiving the light is read one state at a time. It also forces every degree of knowing onto the same scale as degrees of act (part of the commensurability commitment). It does not limit God's self-knowledge, whose act is the greatest degree. Needed: without it, a non-INFINITE_1 intellect COMPREHEND_2s an INFINITE_1 being in a model of the other three premises (Control part 5).
